title: •Hopping Mad
caption: •Hopping Mad (V)
game_text: Deploy on non-{episode1} C-3PO. Once per turn, you may ▲ How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Thank The Maker, We’re Doomed, or Mantellian Savrip. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is {alter}. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat “5” in its game text as “3”.
lore: “I’m standing here in pieces and you’re having delusions of grandeur!”
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Inline black circle 'EPISODE I' icon after 'non-' → {episode1} (stub: 'non-Episode I'); the slip prints the ▲ triangle where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A mid-sentence ('Savrip is [A].') → {alter} (stub: 'Immune to Alter'). Curly apostrophe in We’re and curly double quotes around “5” and “3”. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes around the quote and curly apostrophes in I’m / you’re (wiki has straight single quotes). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible here. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
